gates.title: Baseline and branch protection
gates.requirement: Preserve main; no automatic DB push; snapshot current Supabase

gates.title: Migration reconciliation
gates.requirement: Bring 38 post-freeze migrations into reproducible sequence; test isolated rebuild

gates.title: Public registration / assessment compatibility
gates.requirement: Retire browser calls to revoked RPC; use secure Edge APIs

gates.title: Student identity bridge
gates.requirement: Verified auth→candidate binding and activated candidate; deny unauthorized access

gates.title: Learning UI integration
gates.requirement: Preserve academy and candidate experiences, implement routed English only preview

gates.title: Evidence semantics
gates.requirement: Lesson quiz, career-fit and approved examination remain distinct

gates.title: Editorial & professional release gates
gates.requirement: Courses, lessons, assessments reviewed by subject experts

gates.title: Regression & staging deployment
gates.requirement: Full cross-portal tests then reviewed PR
